macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-pigmented (tan/pinkish) muzzle/chin area and the dark-pigmented (black/dark grey) cheek and periocular regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Moderate vertical thickness with a slight structural droop of the lower lip in a neutral state.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive light-colored pigmentation covering the entire muzzle, philtrum, and chin area, contrasting sharply with the rest of the facial skin.
